extDescription.message: Warns you when your computer is low on memory and helps you restart Chrome without losing your tabs.

noteTitle.message: Your computer is low on memory

noteMessage.message: Restarting Chrome can free some up, and your tabs come back.

popupHigh.message: Your computer is low on memory

startupLink.message: Make sure my tabs come back

welcomeIntro.message: RAM Nudge watches your computer's free memory. When it runs low, it offers a Chrome restart. One quick setup step makes sure your tabs come back afterwards.

welcomeStep.message: In “On startup”, choose “Continue where you left off”.

welcomeNote.message: Chrome doesn't let extensions read this setting, so RAM Nudge can't check it for you. Nothing you do here leaves your browser.

optThreshold.message: Warn me when free memory drops below (%)

restartGuideManual.message: Couldn't copy. Type chrome://restart in the address bar and press Enter; your tabs come back.

restartHint.message: Opens a new tab. Press $KEY$, then Enter: Chrome restarts and your tabs come back.

sleepHint.message: Puts your other tabs to sleep; they reload when you click them.

sleepNone.message: No other tabs to put to sleep.

footerPrivacy.message: Free, no account. Nothing leaves your browser.
